title: Silver Slipper, Ferdinand Trombino and Joe Loi Canna
summary: Frank tells of working seven nights at the Silver Slipper for about 30 dollars, pigtails for dinner, and the owner Judge Hammer and Tony DeFranco.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
